

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Water Horse|kanji=壬午|romaji=mizunoe uma|onyomi=jingo|p=rénwǔ|w=jen-wu|mi=ʐən³⁵ u²¹|y=jam4 ng5|j=jam4 ng5|ci=jɐm ŋo|mc=ɲiɪm ŋo|oc-bs=ɲɨm ŋaʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Water Horse''' (壬午, ''mizunoe uma''; onyomi ''jingo'') is the 19th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 19th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Snake|ja|辛巳}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Goat|af|Waterbok (astrologie)|cdo|Gŭi-ê|de|Wasser-Schaf|fr|Chèvre d'eau|hak|Kui-vi|ja|癸未|ko|계미|nds|Water-Schaap|vi|Quý Mùi|za|Gveiqmeih|zh|癸未|zh_min_nan|Kùi-bī|zh_yue|癸未|qid=Q1062599}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''午'' (Horse) is Yang Fire; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Horse (壬午)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénwǔ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 ng5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-uma
*** On'yomi: jingo
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): imo (임오)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Ngọ

==Months of Yang Water Horse==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose last digit is 0 or 5 (i.e. when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Ten Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)}}), the month of {{ill|May|en|May|qid=Q119|lt=May}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month (Calendar)}} of Ren-Go. However, here the term “month” may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Mangzhong}} until the day before {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Xiaoshu}}) as applicable.
